description: A flex container's text, and a button's, are placed by justify-content and align-items

florui.css: .bar { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 6px; height: 50px; padding: 5px; background-color: #101117; color: #fff; } .btn { display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 46px; height: 40px; border: none; background-color: #345; color: #fff; } .plain { width: 46px; height: 40px; border: none; background-color: #543; color: #fff; } .end { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: flex-end; width: 60px; height: 40px; background-color: #354; } .col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-end; width: 60px; height: 40px; background-color: #445; }

classification.reason: Placement matches Chromium; the remaining difference (about 1% of pixels measured) is the glyph rasterization of the two engines, and a text left unplaced measures about 2.6%.
